Each runtime runs it on its own, every sixty heartbeats (five minutes at the defaults), and only when its journal holds more than 20 000 events or 768 streams or when one node holds 48 streams — then that node's streams alone are due. A stream can go only when it has been silent for longer than the expiry plus 15 minutes, measured on the local clock from the last beat heard or, for a stream never heard beating, from when the journal learned of it (so the streams a restart reloads are not taken for dead at once). A runtime never drops its own stream. Of the streams that could go, one stays while:
